description: This file contains shell script code used for testing Git hook behavior, specifically related to the 'proc-receive' hook and push operations in a Git repository. It includes multiple test cases that simulate pushing branches with and without hooks and verifies the expected output and state of references.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects the command to fail.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes command output to make it consistent/stable for testing.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats expected output and saves it for comparison.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares current references against expected references.
